description.value: Gladstone Brewing Co. is a BC Brewery of the Year award-winner set inside a converted mechanic's garage in the heart of downtown Courtenay, in the Comox Valley. It serves a full scratch-made menu from brunch through dinner alongside its European lagers, Pacific Northwest pale ales, and experimental small-batch beers. Two distinct indoor spaces — the lively Brewers Bar and the intimate Engine Room — plus a large outdoor patio make it a natural gathering spot for locals and travellers alike.
